source_semantics.scanner_identity: The canonical census scanner truncates Razor interpolated href attributes at the nested quote, so the two dynamic Sites anchors dedupe to the single canonical fingerprint @($ -> @($.
source_semantics.dashboard_link: Each authoritative site card links to /sites/{site.Id}.
source_semantics.content_link: Each authoritative site card links to /sites/{site.Id}/explorer.
source_semantics.read_only: Both controls are navigation only and do not mutate local or WordPress state.

laravel_adaptation.frontend: resources/js/sites-interpolated-links-control.tsx binds AIMW-CONT-3A4E69E5D8 only to the Sites row internal navigation pair.
laravel_adaptation.workspace_wiring: resources/js/pages.tsx supplies the active tenant slug plus the authoritative row.id returned by the tenant-scoped Sites collection.
laravel_adaptation.content_context: TenantBootstrap consumes the site query parameter as the active site context, preserving the source intent of opening the selected site's content explorer.
laravel_adaptation.id_safety: Only a positive safe integer site id is accepted; malformed, missing, negative, fractional, padded, or path-like values fail closed with no link.
laravel_adaptation.request_contract: The control derives navigation from the already-authorized Sites read row and performs no extra API request or mutation.

tenant_isolation.active_tenant: The tenant slug is taken from FrontendContext and the id is taken from the active tenant's authoritative Sites query.
tenant_isolation.foreign_tenant: Existing tenant context middleware and membership checks fail closed for a workspace the user does not own.
